headline: Entergy (ETR) Dividend Reaffirmed As Its Undervalued Narrative Faces A Fresh Test
summary: Entergy (ETR) reaffirmed its shareholder payout policy with a declared quarterly dividend of $0.64 per share, payable on September 1, 2026, to investors on record as of August 13, 2026. See our latest analysis for Entergy. Entergy shares have eased in recent weeks, with the 7 day share price return down 7.18% and the 90 day share price return down 7.57%. However, the year to date share price return of 14.66% and 1 year total shareholder return of 23.09% point to longer term momentum supported...
